title_hint: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
summary_hint:
SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

texts.cisa-kev:CVE-2025-42884:
SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

Required action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

en.title: SAP NetWeaver: Improper neutralization vulnerability in data query logic
en.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains a vulnerability in data query logic allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose or modify server information.
en.impact: An unauthenticated attacker can disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

ru.title: SAP NetWeaver: уязвимость нейтрализации элементов в логике запросов данных
ru.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal содержит уязвимость в логике запросов данных, позволяющую неаутентифицированным злоумышленникам раскрывать или изменять информацию на сервере.
ru.impact: Неаутентифицированный злоумышленник может раскрыть или изменить информацию на сервере с помощью внедренных свойств среды JNDI или URL, используемого при операциях поиска JNDI.
ru.fix: В источниках не указаны исправленные версии.
checks: Проведите инвентаризацию установок SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal.
Проверьте системы на предмет доступности и примените смягчающие меры от производителя в соответствии с рекомендациями CISA.

de.title: SAP NetWeaver: Schwachstelle bei Neutralisation von Elementen in Datenabfragelogik
de.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal enthält eine Schwachstelle in der Datenabfragelogik, die es unauthentifizierten Angreifern ermöglicht, Serverinformationen offenzulegen oder zu modifizieren.
de.impact: Ein unauthentifizierter Angreifer kann Serverinformationen über injizierte JNDI-Umgebungseigenschaften oder eine bei JNDI-Lookup-Operationen verwendete URL offenzulegen oder modifizieren.
de.fix: Die Quellen nennen keine korrigierten Versionen.
checks: Inventarisieren Sie SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal-Installationen.
Überprüfen Sie Systeme auf Exponiertheit und wenden Sie vom Hersteller bereitgestellte Mitigationsmaßnahmen gemäß den CISA-Richtlinien an.
